source_families: Federal Reserve Board Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (SHED)
U.S. Department of Agriculture Economic Research Service, Household Food Security in the United States
directional_readout: The independent U.S. series do not move identically: SHED self-assessed wellbeing is flat from 2022 to 2024, while USDA food insecurity rises slightly. Together they show persistent but non-uniform resource pressure, not a common trend estimate.
blocking_items: SHED is adult self-assessed financial wellbeing while USDA is household food insecurity
USDA 2024 change is not statistically significant versus 2023
next_action: Retrieve full codebooks and uncertainty intervals, then pre-specify whether the comparison is a mechanism challenge or a separate U.S. trend lane.
boundary: Independent sources can converge, diverge, or move at different magnitudes without measuring the same population outcome. No pooling or trend promotion is authorized.
